changes: City list unchanged at 27 Italian cities (5 base: Milano, Torino, Verona, Venezia, Trieste; 22 Italia). The wiki Italia page says the DLC has 22 cities, 19 at release; Sardinia (Cagliari, Olbia, Sassari) came free in 1.35. That matches the dataset exactly.

Modena and Vicenza (radio_only) not added. Vicenza shows up only in a ProMods add-on ('Italy Map Rework (Promods addon)': new cities Vicenza, Padua). Nothing shows Modena as a vanilla city. The previous round's 1.62 defs check also found no such cities.
San Marino (SM): no vanilla city. Nothing to add.
Trieste note: confirmed it was added to the base game in update 1.48.5 (12 Oct 2023), as stated by the SCS blog, the wiki 1.48.5 patch notes and eteknix. Also added that it is a ferry port.
Ancona and Bari: added a note on the 1.48.5 rework that gave both new ferry ports for West Balkans/Greece (SCS blog, 9 Sep 2023).
Added ferry Trieste-Ancona (Italia, id trieste_ancona, 10h20m, EUR 335) and Trieste-Bari (Italia, id bari_trieste, 19h10m, EUR 660). Source: the wiki ferry table and a Steam ferry-ID list.
Added ferry Ancona-Durrës (West Balkans, id ancona_durres, 18h, EUR 615), per the wiki ferry table and the Steam ferry-ID list.
Added ferries Ancona-Igoumenitsa and Bari-Igoumenitsa (Greece DLC, ids ancona_igoumenitsa and bari_igoumenitsa, tagged dlc_greece in the Steam ferry-ID list).
Raised Bari-Patras and Ancona-Patras (dlc_greece ids), Bari-Durrës and Ancona-Split (dlc_balkan_w ids, wiki ferry table) from low to high confidence.

Raised Cagliari-Palermo, Napoli-Palermo and Cagliari-Napoli to high confidence. The Steam ferry-ID list has ids cagliari_napoli, cagliari_palermo and napoli_palermo tagged dlc_it. The wiki says Cagliari-Palermo was added in 1.35 and that Sardinia is reached by ferry 'from either Napoli or Palermo'.
Added ferry Sassari-Ajaccio (FR). The wiki Corse page says Corsica has exactly two ferry links: one to mainland France and one to Sardinia (Ajaccio-Sassari), the second needing Italia.

Removed ferries Olbia-Bonifacio and Livorno-Bastia. The wiki Corse page lists only Ajaccio-Sassari as the Corsica-Italy link, and the routes appear nowhere in the in-game ferry-ID or wiki route lists.

Removed ferries Genova-Palermo and Livorno-Palermo. The wiki Sicilia page counts three Sicilian lines (Palermo-Napoli, Messina-Villa San Giovanni, plus Palermo-Cagliari from 1.35), which leaves no room for more Palermo routes, and the dlc_it ferry-ID list has neither. They are real-world GNV routes (and mod routes), not vanilla.

Removed ferries Olbia-Livorno and Olbia-Genova. No in-game ferry ID or wiki route list includes them, and the wiki gives Cagliari (from Napoli or Palermo) as the way to reach Sardinia. The 1.35 Olbia 'marina' is a company depot, not a ferry port.

Graph check: all 27 cities are still connected. Sardinia connects to the mainland through the Cagliari ferries and to Corsica through Sassari-Ajaccio. Road corridors and coordinates were not disproved and are kept as they were.
